blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Two Philippine Military Academy senior cadets are now registered civil engineers after passing this year’s licensure examinations on September 26 and 27, the military school’s public information officer said on Monday night. Army Cadets First Class Daniel F. Castro III of Dumalag, Capiz, and Carls S. Borja of Callao Norte in Lasam, Cagayan, finished their respective civil engineering courses before joining PMA, said Navy Lt. Commander Jesse Nestor Saludo, PMA spokesman. Saludo said Castro “earned his Civil Engineering degree from Capiz State University.” He described Castro as the eldest of three children whose father, Rex, died in a […]...
